messages.title: Database migration in progress
messages.heading: Database migration is in progress
messages.help: Normal operations are temporarily paused to protect the source data.
messages.cancelled: Cancellation requested. The operation will stop at a safe boundary.
messages.stage.waiting_for_database: Waiting for other database operations to finish
messages.stage.activating: Activating MySQL as the source of truth
messages.failure.connection_unreachable.title: Database connection failed
messages.failure.connection_unreachable.message: OpenConcept could not reach the configured database endpoint.
messages.failure.connection_unreachable.action: Check that the database service is running and verify its host, port, DNS, and TLS settings.
messages.failure.authentication_failed.title: Database authentication failed
messages.failure.authentication_failed.message: The database server rejected the configured account credentials.
messages.failure.authentication_failed.action: Verify the account name, password, authentication method, and credential.key backup set.
messages.failure.permissions_insufficient.title: Database permissions are insufficient
messages.failure.permissions_insufficient.message: The connected account does not satisfy the saved OpenConcept permission definition.
messages.failure.permissions_insufficient.action: A database administrator must review the generated recovery SQL and execute it manually. OpenConcept never runs GRANT automatically.
messages.failure.schema_mismatch.title: Database schema mismatch
messages.failure.schema_mismatch.message: The canonical schema does not match the signed OpenConcept schema definition.
messages.failure.schema_mismatch.action: Restore the matching database backup or apply the reviewed versioned schema migration. Automatic drift repair is disabled.
messages.failure.configuration_error.title: Database configuration is invalid
messages.failure.configuration_error.message: OpenConcept could not validate the local adapter, credential, or permission-definition state.
messages.failure.configuration_error.action: Restore and verify the complete database backup set before restarting the service.
messages.failure.selection.title: Database selection conflict
messages.failure.selection.message: A conflicting, multiple, or unverifiable database selection was detected.
messages.failure.selection.policy: OpenConcept stopped the system to protect canonical data.
messages.failure.selection.action: Do not start the application with another database selection. Restore the reviewed canonical configuration before service resumes.
messages.failure.stopped: OpenConcept stopped startup for safety. Automatic fallback, GRANT, and schema repair are disabled.
